bio.text: Brian Burley is the Republican candidate for California's 42nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Robert Garcia.
Burley earned a bachelor's degree in political economy and a master's degree in public policy from the University of Southern California, and owns an information technology consulting company.
Burley has been affiliated with the Orange County Central Committee of the Republican Party in California and was elected to the Huntington Beach City School District in 2024.
